baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural subjects at words 2-3 share the finite verb at word 1 and the destination phrase at words 4-5.
baseline_models.mechanism: Angels and the spirit form a coordinated company whose defining action is upward transit toward one destination.

activation_trace.role: The literal image of ascent supplies the company's upward motion and the mechanism's direction.
The angel branch identifies the plural agents participating in that motion.
The life-spirit branch supplies the separately named co-agent joined to the angels.

changed_reading.before: A bare statement that two named subjects move toward Him.
changed_reading.after: A coordinated heavenly company performs a directed upward transit toward a shared endpoint.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction at words 6-11 predicates a magnitude of one day by fifty thousand years.
baseline_models.mechanism: An open event-span is assigned a measure that reaches an immense extent, and the number itself is compositionally assembled from five, gathered hundreds, and years.

activation_trace.role: The open span-of-time image prevents the day from being restricted to daylight hours.
Temporal predication links the event-span to its stated magnitude.
Measure reaching a thing's extent makes the number a scale specification rather than decoration.
The five-unit image supplies the leading numerical component.
The thousand as gathered hundreds supplies aggregation within the magnitude.
The year branch provides the repeated unit in which the vast measure is expressed.

changed_reading.before: An ordinary day is equated with an anomalously large number of years.
changed_reading.after: A non-ordinary event-span receives an explicitly composed scale whose stated extent is fifty thousand yearly units.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ascent verb at word 1 and the measured duration at words 6-11 occur in one sentence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root inventory permits ascent to carry curvature as well as upwardness, so the measured span may describe traversal through a routed course rather than simple vertical distance.

activation_trace.role: Curving or turning supplies a possible non-rectilinear geometry for the ascent.
Upward ascent keeps that curved geometry attached to the actual verbal action.
Extent-measure lets the temporal quantity register the scale of the routed transit.

changed_reading.before: The duration measures only the height of a straight ascent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the duration can measure passage along a structured, possibly turning route to the endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening fixes the threatened event as something that falls and becomes established and denies any power to ward it off; the immense ascent-scale therefore marks ordered transmission, not uncertainty about whether the event will arrive.

activation_trace.role: The focus measure supplies the apparently immense interval that context reclassifies.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the event's settled arrival.
Warding off an unwanted thing, explicitly negated here, removes preventability from the long scale.

structural_cues: The fixed-event and no-repeller clauses precede the focus verse without an intervening scene change.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed event, negated repulsion, and a vast measure; I infer that the ascent participates in administering the event rather than delaying its certainty, while the live alternative is that the ascent is only adjacent cosmological description.

changed_reading.before: The huge measure can sound like postponement or uncertainty.
changed_reading.after: The huge measure belongs to an ordered process whose threatened terminus is already fixed and unrepellable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding plural 'ascents' turns the focus verb from an isolated upward act into movement through an established architecture of ascent.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the company's actual upward transit.
The same ascent image in a preceding plural noun supplies routes or levels through which the focus motion can be organized.

structural_cues: A divine title built from the same root immediately precedes the finite focus verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent nominal and verbal ascent forms; I infer that the plural noun names an ordered ascent-system used by the agents, while it may alternatively function only as a title of exaltation.

changed_reading.before: The agents make one unstructured upward movement.
changed_reading.after: The agents traverse an already constituted plurality of ascents or levels.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command immediately after the vast measure translates cosmic duration into a human temporal posture: restrain panic without making the waiting ugly or coercive.

activation_trace.role: The focus span supplies the scale to which the commanded posture responds.
Holding the self back from panic supplies disciplined endurance across that span.
Beauty in action qualifies endurance as composed conduct rather than mere delay.

structural_cues: The imperative follows the quantified ascent directly and repeats the patience root as verb and cognate noun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a vast span followed by beautiful self-restraint; I infer an ethical response calibrated to the temporal scale, while the alternative is that patience responds only to rejection of the warning.

changed_reading.before: The temporal scale is cosmological information only.
changed_reading.after: The temporal scale also calibrates a human practice of composed endurance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opposed acts of seeing assign distance differently to the same referent, making the fifty-thousand-year magnitude a perspectival scale rather than evidence that arrival is remote in every frame.

activation_trace.role: The focus measure supplies the numerical scale whose interpretation changes with viewpoint.
Seeing by eye or insight marks the opponents' distance judgment as a viewpoint.
Distance from nearness supplies their classification of the event as remote.
A second act of seeing supplies the explicitly opposed evaluative frame.
Temporal nearness and approaching completion supply the counter-classification of the same event.

structural_cues: The parallel clauses preserve one object while reversing both the viewer and the distance predicate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed viewers and far/near predicates around one referent; I infer that the large measure is frame-dependent in significance, while it may still denote an objective duration viewed with different expectations.

changed_reading.before: Fifty thousand years means simply and universally far away.
changed_reading.after: The same immense scale is judged far from one standpoint and near from another, so magnitude does not settle imminence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The measured day becomes a regime of material phase change: the sky takes on a molten or sedimented consistency while mountains lose rigid mass into soft dyed wool.

activation_trace.role: The focus span supplies the temporal container for the transformed scene.
The severe event-day branch reclassifies the focus span as an occurrence, not just a clock unit.
Molten substances and sediments supply the sky's loss of ordinary stable form.
Soft dyed wool supplies the mountains' conversion from rigid mass to loose material.

structural_cues: Two consecutive similes transform the highest and heaviest visible structures after the near/far reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an event-day and paired material transformations; I infer that the focus measure spans a change of cosmic regime, while the alternative is that the transformations occur only at the terminus after the ascent.

changed_reading.before: The day is an abstract duration attached to ascent.
changed_reading.after: The day is a measured transformation-event in which ordinary cosmic stability ceases.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human default time is jagged: rapid agitation, patience cut off, and good withheld. Continuous and guarded prayer installs a contrary stable rhythm, a human-scale analogue to ordered ascent across an immense span.

activation_trace.role: The focus ascent supplies the sustained macro-process to which the human rhythm is compared.
Greedy, rapidly disturbed panic supplies the unstable default rhythm.
Patience being cut off supplies temporal discontinuity under harm.
The hand withheld from giving supplies blockage when good arrives.
Stillness and continuance supply the corrective rhythm of prayer.
Persistent adherence supplies active maintenance of that rhythm through time.

structural_cues: The exception beginning with the praying ones is bracketed by prayer continuity at 70:23 and prayer guarding at 70:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unstable reactions followed by continuous guarded practice; I infer a microcosmic temporal analogue to the focus ascent, while the live alternative is that the ethical list has no analogical relation to the ascent's duration.

changed_reading.before: The ascent models only heavenly movement on an inaccessible scale.
changed_reading.after: The ordered long-span movement also casts a contrastive pattern for human constancy against panic and blockage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus noun of measure returns as effective capacity, followed by denial that anyone can get beyond reach; the fifty-thousand-year scale therefore expresses deliberate order rather than inability to complete the action sooner.

activation_trace.role: Extent-measure supplies the numerical ordering that could otherwise be mistaken for limitation.
Capacity reaching effective control explicitly supplies ability at the end of the surah.
Escape beyond a pursuer's reach, negated in context, removes any suggestion that the process is outstripped.

structural_cues: The focus measure-root recurs in a first-person plural assertion of power near the close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, effective capacity, and negated escape; I infer that duration is administered order rather than incapacity, while an alternative is that the two uses of the root remain semantically adjacent but functionally independent.

changed_reading.before: The huge duration might imply that the ascent or promised event is slow because of limited power.
changed_reading.after: The huge duration is a chosen measure within effective control, with no agent able to outrun its completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The measured authorized ascent of heavenly agents is spatially reversed at the close by humans forced out of graves and hurried toward an appointed marker in submissive speed: elevated transit contrasts with compelled convergence.

activation_trace.role: Upward ascent supplies the controlled directional motion on one side of the contrast.
Two opposed things coming together supplies the unavoidable convergence with the day.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the convergence point.
Passing out from an enclosure supplies forced emergence from the graves.
The opposite of slowness supplies the scene's abrupt human acceleration.
An erected boundary-marker supplies the visible target of the rush.
Submissive haste supplies the compelled quality of the closing movement.

structural_cues: The branchless root و ف ض at 70:43 is used only as a structural acceleration cue beside 'swiftly' and the goal phrase.
The focus movement is upward and agentive, while the closing movement is out of graves and toward a visible marker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies upward transit, a fixed appointment, emergence, speed, a marker, and submissive haste; I infer a designed motion-contrast, while the live alternative is that the two scenes share only general movement toward judgment.

changed_reading.before: The focus ascent is an isolated heavenly journey.
changed_reading.after: The ascent is one pole of a surah-wide directional contrast: ordered heavenly elevation versus compelled human convergence at the appointed day.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates moving-air and current-like branches beneath words whose direct syntax names the spirit and years; it remains anchored in the focus roots and their shared movement geometry, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as a lexical replacement for either noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The spirit is a co-subject of the ascent, and the temporal unit closes the same motion-and-measure clause.

activation_trace.role: Curving and bending supply the path geometry of the exploratory current image.
Moving air supplies a breath-like carrier for the ascent image.
Elongated one-direction currents supply a long channel through which motion is imagined.

changed_reading.before: The verse juxtaposes agents and a number without a material motion image.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the ascent resembles a breath-current bending through an immensely extended channel.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because three form-distant inventory branches converge on pastoral watering schedules inside an explicitly numerical clause; the recurrence makes a cadence image worth retaining, but downstream prose must label it a branch-level resonance and must not claim that the verse denotes camel watering or irrigation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ascent verb, the five component, and the year unit all occur inside the focus verse's measured temporal construction.

activation_trace.role: The alternating camel-watering interval supplies recurrence within the ascent root.
The five-based camel-watering interval supplies a second independently anchored schedule image.
Water-drawing and irrigation supply the delivery action around which the exploratory schedule turns.
An open span of time contains the recurring cadence without forcing a daylight-day reading.

changed_reading.before: The fifty-thousand-year quantity is a static numeral.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory resonance, the quantity behaves like a vast scheduled cadence of recurrent ascent and delivery.

strongest_changes: The preceding plural ascents convert a single verb into traversal through an ordered ascent architecture.
The far/near reversal makes the huge measure perspectival in significance rather than universally remote.
The closing capacity claim prevents the duration from being read as incapacity, and the grave-exit rush supplies a spatial counter-movement.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse binds directed motion to a deliberately composed temporal measure; context repeatedly changes that bond through route architecture, viewpoint, ethical endurance, material transformation, and contrasting speeds without forcing those readings into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax does not by itself decide whether the fifty-thousand-year measure belongs specifically to the ascent, to the event-day, or to both as one process.
The route-sensitive, current, and watering-cadence readings depend on form-distant branch activation and must remain exploratory.
The analogy between heavenly ordered motion and continuous human practice is structurally suggestive but not explicitly asserted.
